settings.name: Compact window
settings.hint: Remove the window's title bar.

settings.name: Compact layout
settings.hint: Less space between the parts of the sheet.

settings.name: Compact features
settings.hint: Show two lines of each feature; hover for the rest, or click to open it.

settings.name: Collapsible sections
settings.hint: Add a button to fold away each section of features.

font-size.label: Font size
font-size.NaN-error: Font size must be a number.

settings.name: Font size
settings.hint: Text size in pixels; the whole sheet scales with it.

settings.name: Attack descriptions
settings.hint: Write out each attack's bonus, reach and damage from its data.

settings.name: Spellcasting feature
settings.hint: Write out the Spellcasting feature from the monster's spells.

settings.name: Secrets inline
settings.hint: Show secret text like the rest of the text instead of as a separate block.

settings.name: Hide secrets
settings.hint: Leave secret text off the sheet.

settings.name: Hide the picture
settings.hint: Leave the creature's picture off the sheet, as in the books.

settings.name: Use the token image
settings.hint: Show the token image instead of the portrait. The portrait stays on the biography page.

settings.name: Lair actions
settings.hint: Show lair actions, which stat blocks don't normally include.

settings.name: Current hit points
settings.hint: Show the monster's current hit points.

settings.name: Maximum hit points
settings.hint: Show the monster's maximum hit points. With neither shown, the average is shown.

settings.name: Space below stat blocks
settings.hint: Pixels kept free below a stat block window. Less makes sheets taller and narrower; more makes them wider.

settings.name: Theme
settings.hint: How sheets look, unless a sheet's own menu picks another.

settings.name: Custom theme class
settings.hint: The CSS class used by the Custom theme.

settings.name: Editing on
settings.hint: Sheets open ready to edit.

settings.name: Skills and saves without proficiency
settings.hint: List the skills and saves the monster isn't proficient in too.

settings.name: Uses left
settings.hint: Show how many uses and spell slots are left beside the totals.

settings.name: Empty skill and save lines
settings.hint: Show the Skills and Saving Throws lines even when they're empty.

show-delete.disable: Show delete buttons on hover only

settings.name: Proficient in all saves and skills
settings.hint: Give a monster proficiency in every save and skill when it's opened (expertise is kept). This changes the monster's data.

settings.name: Show a monster's stat block when its token is selected
settings.hint: Opens it in a panel at the edge of the screen. The dragon button in the token controls turns this on and off.

pane-on-select.toggle: Primal Monster Blocks panel for the selected token
pane-on-select.on: Primal Monster Blocks panel on: select a token to see its stat block (or the party, for a player character if that option is on).

settings.name: Only show players' characters while they're logged in
settings.hint: A player's character leaves the party sheet when they log out and comes back when they log in. Creatures added by hand always show.

settings.name: Let players use the party sheet
settings.hint: Players can turn the party sheet on for themselves. While this is off, only the GM can use it.

settings.name: Show the party when a player character is selected
settings.hint: With the panel on, shows every player's character: hit points, AC, conditions and effects.

party.title: Party
party.empty: No one is in the party yet.
party.emptyGM: No one is in the party. Drag actors here from the Actors list, or add them with Add to the party in an actor's right-click menu or on a token's HUD.
party.resetConfirm: Go back to just the players' characters? Creatures you added will leave the party, and characters you removed will come back.
party.fromCompendium: Import the actor from the compendium first, then add it to the party.

config.title: Primal Monster Blocks Settings

menu.name: Primal Monster Blocks
menu.label: Open Settings
menu.hint: The stat block panel and party sheet, and how every Primal Monster Blocks sheet looks and what it shows by default.

scope.personal: Just for you: each player chooses their own.
scope.world: For the whole world. These are the defaults; each sheet's own menu can still change them.
scope.mixed: Just for you, apart from the settings marked World setting, which apply to everyone.
scope.mixedWorld: For the whole world. These are the defaults; each sheet's own menu can still change them. Settings marked Just for you are each player's own.

config.partyLocked: Your GM hasn't let players use the party sheet.
config.resetHint: Put this tab's settings back to their defaults. Nothing is saved until you click Save.

settings.name: Party sheet columns
settings.hint: Automatic uses as few columns as it takes to show everyone without scrolling, narrowing Foundry's interface if it has to.

settings.name: Party sheet background
settings.hint: The character sheet banner is dnd5e's dragon artwork behind the cards, tinted with the color below, like the headers of the Tidy 5e character sheets.

settings.name: Banner color
settings.hint: The color the character sheet banner is tinted with.

settings.name: Most columns in a stat block
settings.hint: In the panel and in stat block windows. Each column makes the stat block one column wider, so columns are never squeezed. A stat block that needs more columns than this scrolls instead.

settings.name: Hide the hotbar
settings.hint: Hide Foundry's macro hotbar, always or only while the stat block panel or party sheet is open. The panel gets the room it used.

settings.name: Panel side
settings.hint: Which edge of the screen the panel is on. On the left, it sits beside the 5e.tools panel.

pane-side.left: Left (beside the 5e.tools panel if it is open)

settings.name: Compact skills
settings.hint: Show only Perception and Stealth; click Skills for the full list.

settings.name: Confirm before deleting
settings.hint: Ask before a feature, action or spell is deleted.

attackMods.label: Attack modifiers:
attackMods.toHitHint: Added to every attack roll this creature makes, including spell attacks. Accepts numbers or dice, e.g. 2 or 1d4.
attackMods.damageHint: Added to the damage of every weapon and spell attack. Accepts numbers or dice, e.g. 2 or 1d6.

MOBLOKS5E.CannotSwitchSheet: You must own this actor, and it must not be in a compendium, to change its sheet.

hp.roll: Roll the hit point formula and set current and maximum hit points
hp.average: Set current and maximum hit points to the formula's average
hp.heal: Restore to maximum hit points and clear temporary hit points
hp.noFormula: This creature has no hit point formula.

MOBLOKS5E.physicalDamage: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
MOBLOKS5E.physicalDamageBypass: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from attacks that aren't {bypass}
